# Immune landscape

In this section, we explore the immune landscape of the tumor, highlighting immune-related pathways that vary regionally, immune cell distribution, and changes in immune cell transcriptomes based on environment.


```{r}
#| label: loading preamble
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

source("./preamble.R")
```

## Immune marker genes

We generate a marker gene heatmap for the immune cells specifically, using canonical marker genes for each cell type.
```{r}
#| label: generate_immune_heatmap
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: false

if(!("seu.obj" %in% ls())){
  seu.obj <- readRDS(results_list$seurat_file_postCellTyping)
}

## prepare data for marker gene heatmap:
idx = which(seu.obj$major_cell_type %in% c("dendritic", "Macrophage", "mast", 
                                           "neutrophil", "bcell", "innate_lymphoid", 
                                           "nk", "Plasma", "Tcell"))
ct = "minor_cell_type"
fc_subclus_ctl_gran <- clusterwise_foldchange_metrics(seu.obj[["RNA"]]@counts[,idx]
                                                      ,metadata = seu.obj@meta.data[idx,]
                                                      ,cluster_column = ct
)
# subtract background from the mean per-cluster expression profiles:

# Extract neg counts
neg_counts <- seu.obj@assays$negprobes$counts

for (name in unique(seu.obj@meta.data[idx,ct])) {
  if(is.na(name)){next}
  isthiscelltype <- seu.obj@meta.data[idx,ct] == name
  meannegthiscelltype <- mean(Matrix::colMeans(neg_counts[,idx][, isthiscelltype]))
  idy = fc_subclus_ctl_gran$cluster == name
  fc_subclus_ctl_gran$cluster_expr[idy] <- fc_subclus_ctl_gran$cluster_expr[idy] - meannegthiscelltype
}

fc_subclus_ctl_gran$cluster_expr[which(fc_subclus_ctl_gran$cluster_expr < 0)] <- 0

# Establish one or two well known markers for each cell type
goi <- c('CD3D', 'CD3E', 'CD19', 'MS4A1', 'CD68', 'MARCO', 'ITGAX', 'CLEC9A',
         'KIT', 'CPA3', 'MPO', 'CSF3R', 'NCAM1', 'KLRD1', 'IL7R', 'RORC',
         'JCHAIN', 'MZB1', 'CD8B', 'CD8A', 'CD4', 'CCR7', 'TCF7',
         'CCR6', 'CXCR3', 'STAT4', 'CXCR3', 'GATA3', 'IL4', 'IL17A', 'IL17F',
         'FOXP3', 'CTLA4', 'TCF7', 'IL7R', 'GZMK', 'GZMA', 'SELL', 'GZMB',
         'GNLY', 'LAG3', 'TIGIT', 'SPP1', 'TREM1', 'ARG1', 'MRC1', 'IL1B',
         'TNF', 'IGHA1', 'IGHG1')

hm_goi <- marker_heatmap(fc_subclus_ctl_gran, topn = 0, featsuse = unique(goi)) +
  theme(
    legend.direction = "horizontal", # Arrange items within a legend horizontally
    legend.position = "bottom",    # Place the entire legend box at the bottom
    legend.box = "horizontal"      # Arrange multiple legend boxes horizontally
  )

png(filename = paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Plots/heatmap_", ct, "_immuneOnly_negRemoved_selectIndexMarkers.png"),
    width = 7, height = 4, units = "in", res = 300)
print(hm_goi)
dev.off()

```

## Immune-related pathways

We generate spatial plots of a number of immune-related pathways, focusing only on expression within tumor cells. We perform spatial smoothing across tumor cells.

```{r}
#| label: generate_immunePathways_neighborhood_plots_tumorOnly
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: true
#| eval: false

# if there's no seurat object, read it in
if (!("seu.obj" %in% ls())){
  seu.obj <- readRDS(results_list$seurat_file_postCellTyping)
}

meta <- seu.obj@meta.data

# Read in AUCell results
cells_auc_full <- readRDS(paste0(pathway_dir, "/Data/cellsAUC_"
                                      ,"full"
                                      ,".rds"))

# Calculate smoothed neighborhood expression
xy <- seu.obj@meta.data[,c("x_slide_mm", "y_slide_mm")]
xy$cell_ID <- rownames(xy)

# Use a smoothing function modified from https://nanostring-biostats.github.io/CosMx-Analysis-Scratch-Space/posts/marker-gene-smoothing/
xy_nn <- function(xy, n_neighbors=50){
  xy <- as.data.table(xy)
 
    ## identify nearest n_neighbors (+1 includes the cell as a neighbor to itself)
  nn_xy <- RANN::nn2(xy[,.(x_slide_mm, y_slide_mm)],k = n_neighbors + 1)$nn.idx
  nn_xy <- data.table::melt(cbind(xy[,.(cell_ID)], data.table(nn_xy))
                              , id.vars=c("cell_ID", "V1"))
  colnames(nn_xy) <- c("cell_ID1", "cell_ID1_idx", "neighbor", "cell_ID2_idx")
  nn_xy <- merge(nn_xy
                   , nn_xy[,.(cell_ID2=cell_ID1, cell_ID2_idx=cell_ID1_idx)][
                     ,unique(.SD)],by="cell_ID2_idx")
  
  ## Cell x cell neighbor indicator matrix
  wxy <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = c(unique(nn_xy$cell_ID1_idx), nn_xy$cell_ID2_idx)
                                ,j=c(unique(nn_xy$cell_ID1_idx), nn_xy$cell_ID1_idx)
                                ,x=1)
  
  rownames(wxy) <- colnames(wxy) <- nn_xy[order(nn_xy$cell_ID1_idx),unique(cell_ID1)]
  
  ## Column standardize, so that columns (cells) sum to 1, and each neighbor given equal weight.
  mxy <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(i=1:ncol(wxy)
                                ,j=1:ncol(wxy)
                                ,x=1/Matrix::colSums(wxy)
                                )
  dimnames(mxy) <- dimnames(wxy)
  smoother <- mxy %*% wxy
  smoother <- smoother[,xy$cell_ID]
  return(smoother)
}

# Get smoother for tumor cells only
smoother_tum <- xy_nn(xy[meta$major_cell_type == "Tumor",])

# Plot four key pathways with abbreviated names
key_pathways = c("JAK-STAT" = "REACTOME_GENE_AND_PROTEIN_EXPRESSION_BY_JAK_STAT_SIGNALING_AFTER_INTERLEUKIN_12_STIMULATION",
                 "MHC-1" = "REACTOME_ANTIGEN_PRESENTATION_FOLDING_ASSEMBLY_AND_PEPTIDE_LOADING_OF_CLASS_I_MHC",
                 "NF-kappa B" = "REACTOME_REGULATION_OF_NF_KAPPA_B_SIGNALING",
                 "TNF" = "REACTOME_TNF_SIGNALING"
)
  
# Plot each pathway
for(i in 1:4){
  pathway = key_pathways[i]
  
# Extract pathway scores
path_score <- cells_auc_full[pathway,]
meta$path_score <- path_score[meta$cell_ID]
smoothed_path_score <- meta[which(meta$major_cell_type == "Tumor"),"path_score"] %*% smoother_tum

# Save this smoothed pathway score
saveRDS(smoothed_path_score, file = paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Data/xy_smoothed_tumor_", pathway, ".rds"))

# Plot smoothed pathway in space
meta$smoothed_path_score <- NA
meta[which(meta$major_cell_type == "Tumor"), "smoothed_path_score"] <- smoothed_path_score[1,]
ggplot(meta %>% filter(major_cell_type != "Tumor"), aes(x = x_slide_mm, y = y_slide_mm)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.01, color = "grey80", stroke = 0.1) +
  geom_point(data = meta %>% filter(major_cell_type == "Tumor"),
             aes(x_slide_mm, y_slide_mm, color = smoothed_path_score),
             size = 0.01, stroke = 0.1) +
  scale_color_viridis(option = "plasma") +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_void() +
  ggtitle(paste0(names(key_pathways)[i])) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20))
ggsave(filename = paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Plots/XY_smoothed_tumor_", gsub("-", "_", names(key_pathways)[i]), ".png"),
       width = 2.5, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 400)
}


```

## Impact of niche on CD8 T eff cytotoxic

We group CD8 T cytotoxic cells by novae-defined niches and ask how their transcriptomes differ between broad neighborhoods. We predict that as T cells move more deeply into the tumor, they will become activated or they will go past this to an exhausted state.

### Definition of three niches

Generate a gallery of T cell subtypes showing their distribution across three niches
```{r}
#| label: generate_immune_xy_gallery_broadNiche
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: false

if(!("seu.obj" %in% ls())){
  seu.obj <- readRDS(results_list$seurat_file_postCellTyping)
}

# Read in novae domain assignments
novae_9 <- readRDS(file = paste0(niche_dir, "/Data/novae_domains_9_assignments.rds"))

# Add to metadata
meta <- seu.obj@meta.data
meta$novae_9 <- novae_9[row.names(meta)]

# Add broad niche assignments
exteriornames <- paste0("D", c(987, 1003))
interiornames <- paste0("D", c(1014,1007,1008, 1011))
tumornames <- paste0("D", c(1012,1013,976))
 
bigniche <- as.character(novae_9)
bigniche[is.element(novae_9, exteriornames)] <- "Exterior stroma"
bigniche[is.element(novae_9, interiornames)] <- "Interior stroma"
bigniche[is.element(novae_9, tumornames)] <- "Tumor bed"
names(bigniche) <- names(novae_9)

meta$broad_niche_v2 <- bigniche[row.names(meta)]

# For this plot, remove any cells which are not assigned a niche (this is 16 cells)
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$broad_niche_v2),]

# Plot only T cells
idx = which(meta$major_cell_type %in% c("Tcell"))

ggplot(meta[idx,],
       aes(x = x_slide_mm, y = y_slide_mm)) +
  geom_point(data = df2, color = "grey90", size = 0.01, alpha = 0.05) + # Background cells
  geom_point(aes(color = broad_niche_v2), size = 0.01, alpha = 0.5)+ # Foreground highlighted cells
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Exterior stroma" = "#56B4E9",
                                "Interior stroma" = "#D55E00",
                                "Tumor bed" = "#000000"), name = "") +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_void() +
  facet_wrap(~minor_cell_type, nrow = 2) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5, alpha = 1))) +
  theme(
    legend.direction = "horizontal", # Arrange items within a legend horizontally
    legend.position = "bottom"    # Place the entire legend box at the bottom
  )
  
ggsave(paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Plots/gallery_TCells_broadNiche2.png"),
       width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")

# Make a zoomed in plot of CD8 cytotoxic showing three colors plus tumor
idx = which(meta$minor_cell_type == "cd8_teff_cytotoxic")

ggplot(meta[idx,],
       aes(x = x_slide_mm, y = y_slide_mm)) +
  geom_point(data = meta %>% filter(major_cell_type != "Tumor"), 
             color = "grey90", size = 0.1, alpha = 0.7) + # Background cells
  geom_point(data = meta %>% filter(major_cell_type == "Tumor"), 
             color = "grey70", size = 0.01, alpha = 0.7) + # Tumor cells
  geom_point(aes(color = broad_niche_v2), size = 0.5, alpha = 1)+ # Foreground highlighted cells
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Exterior stroma" = "#56B4E9",
                                "Interior stroma" = "#D55E00",
                                "Tumor bed" = "#000000"), name = "") +
```

### Differential expression analysis

We run differential expression analysis to compare these T cells across three niches.
```{r}
#| label: run_DE_cd8eff_byBroadNiche
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: true
#| eval: false

# if there's no seurat object, read it in
if (!("seu.obj" %in% ls())){
  seu.obj <- readRDS(results_list$seurat_file_postCellTyping)
}

# Read in novae domain assignments
novae_9 <- readRDS(file = paste0(niche_dir, "/Data/novae_domains_9_assignments.rds"))

# Add to metadata
meta <- seu.obj@meta.data
meta$novae_9 <- novae_9[row.names(meta)]

# Add broad niche assignments
exteriornames <- paste0("D", c(987, 1003))
interiornames <- paste0("D", c(1014,1007,1008, 1011))
tumornames <- paste0("D", c(1012,1013,976))
 
bigniche <- as.character(novae_9)
bigniche[is.element(novae_9, exteriornames)] <- "exterior stroma"
bigniche[is.element(novae_9, interiornames)] <- "interior stroma"
bigniche[is.element(novae_9, tumornames)] <- "tumor bed"
names(bigniche) <- names(novae_9)

meta$broad_niche <- bigniche[row.names(meta)]

## Run DE across broad niches on CD8 T cells only

# Pre-de find neighbors
if(!file.exists(paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Data/pre_de_obj.rds"))){
pre_de_obj <- pre_de(
  metadata = meta,
  cell_type_metadata_colname = "minor_cell_type",
  mm_radius = 0.05,
  sdimx_colname = "x_slide_mm",
  sdimy_colname = "y_slide_mm",
  verbose = TRUE,
  adjacencies_only = TRUE
)
# Save pre-de
saveRDS(pre_de_obj, file = paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Data/pre_de_obj.rds"))
} else{
  pre_de_obj <- readRDS(paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Data/pre_de_obj.rds"))
}

# Add total counts to metadata as DE expects
meta$totalcounts = meta$nCount_RNA

# Calculate overlap metrics
if(!file.exists(paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Data/overlap_metrics.rds"))){
overlap_metrics <- 
smiDE::overlap_ratio_metric(assay_matrix = seu.obj@assays$RNA$data,
                           metadata = meta,
                           cluster_col = "minor_cell_type",
                           radius = 0.05,
                           #split_neighbors_by_colname = "Run_Tissue_name",
                           sdimx_col = "x_slide_mm",
                           sdimy_col = "y_slide_mm"
                           )

# Save overlap metrics
saveRDS(overlap_metrics, file = paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Data/overlap_metrics.rds"))
} else{
  overlap_metrics <- readRDS(paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Data/overlap_metrics.rds"))
}

 # Only analyze genes with ratio less than or equal to 1
  analysis_genes <- overlap_metrics[minor_cell_type == "cd8_teff_cytotoxic" & ratio <= 1]$target

# DE test dependence on big niche
de_obj <- smi_de(
  assay_matrix = seu.obj@assays$RNA@counts[analysis_genes,],
  metadata = meta[which(meta[,"minor_cell_type"] == "cd8_teff_cytotoxic"),],
  formula = ~RankNorm(otherct_expr) + broad_niche + offset(log(totalcounts)),
  pre_de_obj = pre_de_obj,
  groupVar = "broad_niche",
  neighbor_expr_cell_type_metadata_colname = "minor_cell_type",
  neighbor_expr_totalcount_normalize = TRUE,
  neighbor_expr_totalcount_scalefactor = NULL,
  family = "nbinom2",
  targets = analysis_genes,
  nCores = 12
)

# Save object
saveRDS(de_obj, file = paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Data/cd8teff_broadNiche_de_obj.rds"))

```

We plot the differences in a volcano plot for all pairwise comparisons. 
```{r}
#| label: plotDE_cd8teff_broadNiche
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| eval: false

# Read in DE object
de_obj <- readRDS(paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Data/cd8teff_broadNiche_de_obj.rds"))

# Extract pairwise results, then plot for each bin contrast
pairwise.df <- results(de_obj, "pairwise")$pairwise
pairwise.df <- pairwise.df %>% filter(term == "broad_niche")

pairwise.df$contrast <- droplevels(pairwise.df$contrast)

for(contrast_i in unique(pairwise.df$contrast)){
  pairwise.df_i <- pairwise.df %>% filter(contrast == contrast_i)
  
  
  # Adjust p-value
  pairwise.df_i$p.adj <- p.adjust(pairwise.df_i$p.value, method = "bonferroni")
  
  # Plot it, partially following smiDE volcano code
  
  # Extract comparison
  cc = pairwise.df_i$contrast[1]
  compv = compv <- strsplit(as.character(cc), "\\ vs.\\ ")[[1]]
  if(grepl(" [\\/-]\\ ", cc)) compv <- strsplit(as.character(cc), "\\ [\\/-]\\ ")[[1]]
  
  # x labels
  xrng <- pairwise.df_i[!is.na(log2(fold_change)),c(min(-log2(fold_change)),max(-log2(fold_change)))]
  xrng <- c(-max(abs(xrng)), max(abs(xrng)))
  xrng <- pretty(xrng)
  
  # Set up y labels
  nDigits <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.integer(strsplit(x = formatC(formatC(x = x, format="e"), format = "s"), split = "e")[[1]][2]))
  bonf<- pairwise.df_i[,0.05/(uniqueN(target) * uniqueN(contrast))]
  max.y <- nDigits(min(pairwise.df_i[,min(p.value)+10^-300], signif(bonf / 2, 1)))
  
  ybrk <- 1 * 10^pretty( c(-1:(max.y)) )
  ylab <- ybrk
  
  # Add coloring
  fc_cutoff = 0.5
  pairwise.df_i$sig_group = paste0("P adj > 0.05\nand/or\nlog2FC < ", fc_cutoff)
  pairwise.df_i$sig_group[intersect(which(pairwise.df_i$p.adj < 0.05),
                                    which(log2(pairwise.df_i$fold_change) > fc_cutoff))] <- compv[1]
  pairwise.df_i$sig_group[intersect(which(pairwise.df_i$p.adj < 0.05),
                                    which(log2(pairwise.df_i$fold_change) < -fc_cutoff))] <- compv[2]
  my_cols = c("tomato3", "lightskyblue3", "lightgrey")
  names(my_cols) = c(compv[1],
                     compv[2],
                     paste0("P adj > 0.05\nand/or\nlog2FC < ", fc_cutoff))
  
  # Show gene names
  ggplot(pairwise.df_i,
         aes(x = log2(fold_change), y = p.value + 10^-300)) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = bonf, linetype = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = fc_cutoff, linetype = 2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = -fc_cutoff, linetype = 2) +
    geom_point(aes(color = sig_group), size = 0.6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = my_cols, name = "Significance group") +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = smiDE:::change_axis_revlog_trans(base=10),
                       breaks = ybrk,
                       labels = formatC(ylab, format = "e", digits = 0)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = xrng, limits = range(xrng)) +
    theme_bw() +
    ylab("p value") +
    xlab(paste0(compv[2], " ", sprintf('\u2190'), " log", sprintf('\u2082'), "(FC) ", sprintf('\u2192'), " ", compv[1]) ) + 
    geom_text_repel(data = pairwise.df_i %>% filter(sig_group == compv[[2]]), aes(label = target, 
                                                                                  x = log2(fold_change), y = p.value + 10^-300),
                    color = my_cols[[compv[2]]]) +
    geom_text_repel(data = pairwise.df_i %>% filter(sig_group == compv[[1]]), aes(label = target, 
                                                                                  x = log2(fold_change), y = p.value + 10^-300),
                    color = my_cols[[compv[1]]])
  ggsave(filename = paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Plots/volcano_cd8teff_broadNiche_v2_", compv[2], "_", compv[1], "_plusGeneNames.png"))
  
}

```

In addition to these volcano plots for each pairwise comparison, we make one summary plot that shows estimated mean for each broad niche and pairwise significance. Estimated mean is shown relative to the location with the highest expression. Only genes reaching significance in at least one pairwise comparison are shown.
Also save the table of DE results to be provided as a supplementary table.
```{r}
#| label: plotDE_cd8teff_broadNiche_v2_heatmap
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| eval: false

# Read in DE object
de_obj <- readRDS(paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Data/cd8teff_broadNiche_de_obj.rds"))

# Extract estimated means
em_res <- results(de_obj)$emmeans %>% filter(term == "broad_niche")

# Extract pairwise results
pairwise.df <- results(de_obj, "pairwise")$pairwise

# Conversions of some data names
if("broad_niche_v2" %in% pairwise.df$term){
  pairwise.df$term = gsub("broad_niche_v2", "broad_niche", pairwise.df$term)
}
pairwise.df <- pairwise.df %>% filter(term == "broad_niche")

# Add fdr
pairwise.df$fdr = p.adjust(pairwise.df$p.value, method = "fdr")

# Save pairwise results to a table to be included as supplementary information.
write.csv(as.data.frame(pairwise.df)[,c(setdiff(colnames(pairwise.df), c("df", "null", "fold_change")))],
          file = paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Data/CD8TcytotoxicBroadNicheDE_table.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)


# Select all genes that have fdr < 0.05 in any comparison
de_genes <- pairwise.df %>% filter(fdr < 0.05) %>% pull(target) %>% unique()

# Extract estimated means for all de genes
em_de <- em_res %>% filter(target %in% de_genes)

# Filter for significant genes (FDR < 0.05) and count number and type of DE comparisons per gene
de_signature <- pairwise.df %>%
  filter(fdr < 0.05) %>%
  distinct(target, contrast) %>%
  group_by(target) %>%
  summarise(
    de_signature = paste(sort(unique(contrast)), collapse = "_"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Prepare expression matrix
expr_matrix <- em_de %>%
  dplyr::select(target, level, response) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = level, values_from = response) %>%
  column_to_rownames("target")

# Scale each row to [0, 1] by dividing by row max
expr_scaled <- t(apply(expr_matrix, 1, function(x) x / max(x, na.rm = TRUE)))

# Create annotation for DE count
# Merge DE count with expression matrix rownames
de_annotation <- data.frame(target = rownames(expr_scaled)) %>%
  left_join(de_signature, by = "target") 

# Define color palette for DE signature

de_levels <- c(
  "none",  # no DE
  "exterior stroma / interior stroma",
  "exterior stroma / tumor bed",
  "interior stroma / tumor bed",
  "exterior stroma / interior stroma_exterior stroma / tumor bed",
  "exterior stroma / interior stroma_interdigitated stroma / tumor bed",
  "exterior stroma / tumor bed_interior stroma / tumor bed",
  "exterior stroma / interior stroma_exterior stroma / tumor bed_interior stroma / tumor bed"
)

de_annotation$de_signature <- factor(de_annotation$de_signature,
                                     levels = de_levels)

# Assign colors based on number of comparisons
de_colors <- c(
  "none" = "#d9d9d9",  # neutral gray
  "exterior stroma / interior stroma" = "#91bfdb",  # cool blue
  "exterior stroma / tumor bed" = "#a6d96a",  # cool green
  "interior stroma / tumor bed" = "#c2a5cf",  # cool purple
  "exterior stroma / interior stroma_exterior stroma / tumor bed" = "#ffd92f",  # bright yellow
  "exterior stroma / interior stroma_interior stroma / tumor bed" = "#f46d43",  # warm coral
  "exterior stroma / tumor bed_interior stroma / tumor bed" = "#e6a141",  # warm amber
  "exterior stroma / interior stroma_exterior stroma / tumor bed_interior stroma / tumor bed" = "#d73027"  # hot red
)

## Cluster genes within each group

# Create a list to store ordered gene names
ordered_genes <- c()

# Loop through each DE signature group
for (group in de_levels) {
  genes_in_group <- de_annotation %>%
    filter(de_signature == group) %>%
    pull(target)
  
  if (length(genes_in_group) > 1) {
    # Subset expression matrix
    submatrix <- expr_scaled[genes_in_group, ]
    
    # Compute hierarchical clustering
    hc <- hclust(dist(submatrix))
    
    # Get ordered gene names
    ordered_genes <- c(ordered_genes, genes_in_group[hc$order])
  } else {
    # If only one gene, just add it
    ordered_genes <- c(ordered_genes, genes_in_group)
  }
}

# Set gene order for expression matrix and annotation
expr_scaled_ordered <- expr_scaled[ordered_genes, ]

# Reorder annotation to match
de_annotation_ordered <- de_annotation[match(ordered_genes, de_annotation$target), ]

# Use shorter DE signature names
# Mapping long DE signature strings to short labels
de_signature_labels <- c(
  "none" = "None",
  "exterior stroma / interior stroma" = "E vs I",
  "exterior stroma / tumor bed" = "E vs T",
  "interior stroma / tumor bed" = "I vs T",
  "exterior stroma / interior stroma_exterior stroma / tumor bed" = "E vs I & E vs T",
  "exterior stroma / interior stroma_interior stroma / tumor bed" = "E vs I & I vs T",
  "exterior stroma / tumor bed_interior stroma / tumor bed" = "E vs T & I vs T",
  "exterior stroma / interior stroma_exterior stroma / tumor bed_interior stroma / tumor bed" = "All (E vs I, E vs T, I vs T)"
)

names(de_colors) <- de_signature_labels[names(de_colors)]

# Apply to factor levels
de_annotation_ordered$de_signature <- factor(
  de_annotation_ordered$de_signature,
  levels = names(de_signature_labels),
  labels = de_signature_labels
)

# Create row annotation
row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  DE_Signature = de_annotation_ordered$de_signature,
  col = list(DE_Signature = de_colors),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    DE_Signature = list(title = "Significant contrasts")
  )

)

## Label specific genes of interest


# Identify two representative genes per group
# Add gene names to expression matrix
expr_scaled_ordered_df <- as.data.frame(expr_scaled_ordered)
expr_scaled_ordered_df$target <- rownames(expr_scaled_ordered_df)

# Target list chosen based on expected biology, unexpected but plausible, and present in one or more contrasts
genes_of_interest <- c("PDCD1", "KLRG1", "CXCR4", "RPL28", 
                       "SARDH", "CD69",
                        "KLRB1", "GIMAP4",  "CD44",
                       "PRDM1", "KLRK1", "CCR2", "EVL", "GNLY", "H2BC4", "H1-4", 
                       "ID2", "CXCR3", "ANXA1")


# Find the indices of these genes in the matrix
gene_indices = which(rownames(expr_scaled_ordered) %in% genes_of_interest)

# Create a row annotation with anno_mark()
# This annotation will place the gene labels on the right side.
gene_labels_anno = rowAnnotation(
  gene_labels = anno_mark(
    at = gene_indices,
    labels = rownames(expr_scaled_ordered)[gene_indices],
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),  # Adjust label font size
    link_width = unit(5, "mm")       # Adjust line length
  )
)

# Rename columns to include shorthand
colnames(expr_scaled_ordered) <- dplyr::recode(
  colnames(expr_scaled_ordered),
  "exterior stroma" = "Exterior stroma (E)",
  "interior stroma" = "Interior stroma (I)",
  "tumor bed" = "Tumor bed (T)"
)

# Generate heatmap
hm <- Heatmap(
  expr_scaled_ordered,
  name = "Scaled Expression",
  col = colorRamp2(c(0, 1), c("white", "grey30")),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  left_annotation = row_ha,
  row_split = de_annotation_ordered$de_signature,
  row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 0),
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  right_annotation = gene_labels_anno
)

png(filename = paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Plots/heatmap_cd8teff_broadNiche_v2_selectedGenes.png"),
    width = 4, height = 6, units = "in", res = 400)
draw(hm)
dev.off()

```

Heatmap of genes differentially expressed across broad niches:

T-cell abundance by spatial location:

```{r echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
niches <- readRDS(paste0(niche_dir, "/Data/novae_domains_9_assignments.rds"))
bigniche <- rep(NA, nrow(seu.obj@meta.data))
bigniche[is.element(niches, paste0("D", c(987, 1003)))] <- "exterior stroma" 
bigniche[is.element(niches, paste0("D", c(976, 1012, 1013)))] <- "tumor interior"
bigniche[is.element(niches, paste0("D", c(1007, 1008, 1014, 1011)))] <- "interior stroma"

tab <- table(bigniche, seu.obj@meta.data$minor_cell_type)
tab <- tab[, grepl("cd", colnames(tab))]
o <- hclust(dist(t(tab)))$order
```

T cell abundance vs. neighborhood path score:

```{r echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
pathscores <- readRDS(paste0(pathway_dir, "/Data/cellsAUC_full.rds"))
pathnames <- pathscores@Dimnames[[1]]
# find relevant pathway names:
pathnames[grepl("JAK_STAT", pathnames)]
pathnames[grepl("MHC", pathnames)]
pathnames[grepl("NF_KAPPA_B", pathnames)]
pathnames[grepl("TNF_SIGN", pathnames)]
# get scores:
pathscores0 <- t(as.matrix(pathscores[c("REACTOME_GENE_AND_PROTEIN_EXPRESSION_BY_JAK_STAT_SIGNALING_AFTER_INTERLEUKIN_12_STIMULATION",
                           "REACTOME_ANTIGEN_PRESENTATION_FOLDING_ASSEMBLY_AND_PEPTIDE_LOADING_OF_CLASS_I_MHC",
                           "REACTOME_REGULATION_OF_NF_KAPPA_B_SIGNALING",
                           "REACTOME_TNF_SIGNALING"), ]))
colnames(pathscores0) <- c("JAK-STAT", "MHC-I", "NF-kappa B", "TNF")


if (!file.exists(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/neighbors100.RDS"))) {
  neighbors100 <- InSituCor:::nearestNeighborGraph(x = xy[, 1], y = xy[, 2], N = 100)
  saveRDS(neighbors100, file = paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/neighbors100.RDS"))
} else {
  neighbors100 <- readRDS(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/neighbors100.RDS"))
}

tnames <- unique(seu.obj@meta.data$minor_cell_type)[grepl("cd", unique(seu.obj@meta.data$minor_cell_type))]
tempcelltype <- replace(seu.obj@meta.data$minor_cell_type, !is.element(seu.obj@meta.data$minor_cell_type, tnames), "other")
celltypemat <- model.matrix(lm(raw[,1] ~ tempcelltype - 1))
colnames(celltypemat) <- gsub("tempcelltype", "", colnames(celltypemat))
tabundance <- InSituCor:::neighbor_colSums(celltypemat, neighbors100)
tabundance <- tabundance[, colnames(tabundance) != "other"]
istumor <- grepl("tumor", seu.obj@meta.data$minor_cell_type)
cormat <- cor(as.matrix(pathscores0[istumor, ]), as.matrix(tabundance[istumor, ]))

# model pathway scores ~ t cell abundance:
temp.p <- temp.est <- cormat*NA
mat <- cbind(as.matrix(tabundance[istumor, ]), model.matrix(pathscores0[istumor,1] ~ seu.obj@meta.data$minor_cell_type[istumor] - 1))
for (path in colnames(pathscores0)) {
  mod <- lm(scale(pathscores0[istumor, path]) ~ mat)
  temp.p[path, ] <- summary(mod)$coef[paste0("mat",colnames(temp.est)), 4]
  temp.est[path, ] <- summary(mod)$coef[paste0("mat",colnames(temp.est)), 1]
}


round(temp.est * (temp.p < 1e-2), 2)

pheatmap(temp.est * (temp.p < 1e-2), display_numbers = T, cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F,
         col = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
         breaks = seq(-0.15,0.15,length.out=101))
         

svg(paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Plots/T-cells vs pathscores - multivariate.svg"), width = 6.5, height = 2.5)
pheatmap(temp.est * (temp.p < 1e-2), display_numbers = T, cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F,
         col = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
         breaks = seq(-0.1,0.1,length.out=101))#breaks = seq(-0.35,0.35,length.out=101))
dev.off()
write.csv(temp.est, file = paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Data/pathway vs. tcells - estimates.csv"))
write.csv(temp.p, file = paste0(immNeigh_dir, "/Data/pathway vs. tcells - pvals.csv"))
```
